title: Subjectivity-Intersection Braid Quantum Gravity: A Constructive Refutation of Objectivist Primacy from Source-Derived Quantum Dynamics to the Einstein Limit
description: We develop Subjectivity-Intersection Braid Quantum Gravity as a source-explicit mathematical quantum-gravity candidate in which a public Lorentzian spacetime carrier is generated by intersections of nonidentical, standpoint-bearing pointed-Braid processes. Version 0.93 retains the complete 65-page v0.92 manuscript and adds two scoped matter results. In a declared derived unital dagger-compact pointed-oriented Nambu-Lie completion, a joint clock-pair bracket with the already fixed clock rate c=1 forces the positive pair rate s=1; the same unital action fixes y_nu=1. Canonical normalization of K=Y Y^T yields one device-relative coefficient and six positive nondegenerate neutral mass-energy modes without observed-data fitting. Source-typed flavour covariantization then yields numerical source-order CKM and PMNS generation matrices and a physical 3x6 active-neutral charged-current matrix. All six observed-name dictionaries are retained as one finite permutation orbit, and none is selected by hand. These are unfitted theoretical outputs, not evidence of agreement with measured CKM/PMNS data. Observed particle names, universal SI traceability, RG flow, total uncertainty, independent replication, and empirical quantum-gravity validation remain open.
